card.name: Inside long medical terms like myopathy
card.fires_on: Responds to a middle piece of a long medical word, such as the OP in myopathy, ld in methyldopa, or osis in mucormycosis. It appears mostly in warning headings and adverse-reaction lists.

modes.label: my- disease terms
modes.description: Middle piece of muscle or eye terms that start with my, such as myopathy, polymyositis, myopic.

modes.label: Inside methyldopa
modes.description: The ld piece in the drug name methyldopa.

modes.label: Other split disease words
modes.description: Pieces of long condition names such as mucormycosis or microembolism.
